# 華嚴關脈義記

**ID:** T1879b
**Volume:** T45
**Category:** 華嚴部類
**Original Category:** 諸宗部
**Date:** 643–712
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1879b

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the anonymous companion to *[Fǎzàng's Huáyán jīng guānmài yì jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0095)* (T1879a) — given by the Taishō editors as T1879b ("b" indicating the variant or parallel text printed alongside T1879a). The two texts are closely related but textually distinct. Modern scholarship is divided on whether the anonymous variant represents an earlier draft of Fǎzàng's work, a parallel composition by an unnamed contemporary, or a substantially independent work in the same genre.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally placed in the broader Tang period, with its attribution to either [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's circle or a near-contemporary anonymous Huáyán-school author. The bracket adopted here (670 – 800) reflects this maximum window. The doctrinal substance closely parallels [T1879a](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0095) — treatment of the *guānmài* 關脈 (critical articulations) of the *Avataṃsaka*'s structure — but with subtle differences in detail and emphasis.

The Taishō text (T1879b) is established on the *yuán* 原 (original-block) witness; the textual transmission is parallel to but distinct from T1879a.
